config.note: Reproduction of the synthetic logistic example of Diao et al. Their prior is improper and flat, so the potential is convex but not strongly convex: alpha = 0 and every optimizer-whitened constant of Assumption 2.1 is undefined. A negligible ridge of 1e-8 is used instead, which keeps those constants finite while changing the posterior by far less than the quadrature error of this cell. Stepsizes are given explicitly rather than as multiples of a certified scale, because no positive step is certified at that alpha.
